cases.name: forward_on_open_ground
cases.why: One second of forward travel is exactly the speed constant.

cases.name: diagonal_is_not_faster
cases.why: Forward and strafe together normalise; diagonals do not sprint.

cases.name: turning_while_moving
cases.why: Yaw changes mid-run; the direction follows the look each frame.

cases.name: runs_into_the_arena_wall
cases.why: The bounds clamp holds at the edge and does not creep past it.

cases.name: slides_along_centre_cover
cases.why: Walking into the central pillar stops, then slides along it.

cases.name: long_frame_is_clamped
cases.why: A frame claiming a huge dt travels the clamp, not the claim.

cases.name: idle_and_zero_dt_do_not_move
cases.why: No buttons, and a zero-length frame, are both no-ops.

cases.name: atrium_long_wall
cases.why: The second arena's long central wall resolves the same way.
